LeaseCommencement.label: Lease Initial Recognition
LeaseCommencement.description: ROU asset recognised on the balance sheet at lease commencement date — asset debited, lease liability credited at present value of future payments.

6181.detail: Short-term / operating lease expense account (6181) posted at commencement — this is a finance lease that requires an ROU asset. Reclassify in D365 Lease setup.

Depreciation.label: Monthly ROU Asset Depreciation
Depreciation.description: Monthly depreciation of the right-of-use asset — charge debited to P&L, accumulated depreciation credited. Under French GAAP with PMA enabled, an additional provision entry (68725 / 1510) is required.

661.detail: General interest account (661) used instead of lease interest (6618). Update the Lease Posting Profile Interest Expense Account.

6615.detail: Current account interest (6615) posted instead of IFRS 16 lease interest (6618). Likely a wrong posting profile selection.

InterestAccrual.label: Lease Interest Accrual
InterestAccrual.description: Monthly unwinding of the discount on the lease liability using the effective interest method — interest expense debited, interest payable credited.

661.detail: General interest expense (661) used for lease interest — use IFRS 16-specific account 6618. Update Lease Posting Profile.

6615.detail: Current account interest (6615) posted instead of IFRS 16 lease interest (6618). Likely a wrong posting profile selection.

6181.detail: Operating lease expense account (6181) posted for a finance lease interest accrual. Check lease classification in D365.

Payment.label: Lease Payment
Payment.description: Cash payment of a lease instalment — lease liability debited (principal portion), bank account credited.

VariablePayment.label: Variable / Short-term Lease Payment
VariablePayment.description: Expense-basis payment for variable leases or short-term / low-value leases not on-balance-sheet — expense debited directly, bank or vendor credited.
